legal.title: Privacy notice
legal.body: Your files never leave this device. Media Comparer reads them only in your browser — there is no upload, no server storage, and no cloud sync of your media.

dropzone.title: Drop files here or click to browse

dropzone.rejectType: That file type is not allowed on this tab.

grid.empty: Add at least two files to compare metadata side by side.

fieldHelp.fileName: The original file name on disk. Useful to spot renamed exports of the same media.
fieldHelp.fileSize: Raw byte size of the file. Smaller often means stronger compression or fewer pixels/samples.
fieldHelp.mimeType: Browser-reported media type (for example image/png or video/mp4).
fieldHelp.extension: Filename extension such as .jpg or .mkv. May differ from the real container/codec.
fieldHelp.width: Horizontal pixel count of the image or video frame.
fieldHelp.height: Vertical pixel count of the image or video frame.
fieldHelp.resolution: Width × height. Higher resolution usually means more detail and larger files.
fieldHelp.colorSpace: How color values are interpreted (sRGB, Display P3, etc.). Mismatches can change how colors look.
fieldHelp.bitDepth: Bits used per color channel. 8-bit is common; 10/12/16-bit hold more tonal detail.
fieldHelp.compression: Container/format or EXIF compression tag (PNG, JPEG, WebP, etc.).
fieldHelp.make: Camera manufacturer from EXIF. Often missing on screenshots and edited exports.
fieldHelp.model: Camera model from EXIF. Often missing unless the shot came from a camera/phone.
fieldHelp.orientation: EXIF rotation hint so viewers can display the image upright.
fieldHelp.container: File wrapper format (mp4, matroska/mkv, webm, wav…). Different from the codec inside.
fieldHelp.videoCodec: Algorithm that encodes video frames (H.264/AVC, HEVC, VP9, AV1…). Affects quality, size, and compatibility.
fieldHelp.audioCodec: Algorithm that encodes audio (AAC, Opus, MP3, FLAC…). Affects quality, size, and compatibility.
fieldHelp.frameRate: Frames per second (fps). Higher fps looks smoother but needs more bitrate.
fieldHelp.bitrate: Average data rate. Higher bitrate usually preserves more quality for the same resolution/codec.
fieldHelp.sampleRate: Audio samples per second (for example 44100 Hz or 48000 Hz).
fieldHelp.pixelFormat: How luminance/chroma are stored (yuv420p, yuv444p, rgb24…). yuv420 is common and more compressed; yuv444 keeps full chroma detail.

diff.title: Difference

diff.clickHint: Click a row to learn why it differs.
diff.missingCameraMeta: Camera EXIF is often missing on screenshots and exported images.
diff.detailBody: Each colored badge matches a file in the grid. Review values side by side.

tour.tabsBody: Each tab keeps comparisons separate — images with images, videos with videos, audio with audio.
tour.dropBody: Drag and drop or browse. Nothing is uploaded to a server.
tour.themeBody: Switch between light, dark, or system preference anytime.
